LanguageData.Cinder_Magistrate.label: Magistrate shotgun
LanguageData.Cinder_Magistrate.description: An ancient design of shotgun that use special dart bullets. Deadly, but short range.Sometimes tentacles grow on the muzzle of a gun.
LanguageData.Cinder_MP12A.label: Needle PDW
LanguageData.Cinder_MP12A.description: An ancient rapid fire armor piercing submachine gun/short rifle that uses armor piercing ammunition and was used as a weapon for vehicle crew members or operators to confront armed soldiers, occasionally this gun grows some strange tentacles.
LanguageData.Cinder_PCX33A.label: Ouroboros rifle
LanguageData.Cinder_PCX33A.description: An ancient Hi-Power rifle,The actual damage it causes is not as simple as it seems.Its special warhead will shatter upon hitting the target, causing serious damage,Not clearing what twisted it, occasionally this gun grows some strange tentacles.
LanguageData.Cinder_Flint50A.label: Flint anti material rifle
LanguageData.Cinder_Flint50A.description: An ancient anti material assault rifle that uses large caliber bullets and can effectively destroy lightly armored targets or military equipment, with a recoil that is difficult to withstand, occasionally this gun grows some strange tentacles.
LanguageData.Cinder_Dragonslayer.label: Dragon slayer Bow
LanguageData.Cinder_Dragonslayer.description: An ancient extended range anti armor rocket launcher that destroys heavy armor by launching tentacle shaped charge bombs inside. It can also transform into a minigun to deal with cluster targets.
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionGourd.label: erosion gourd
LanguageData.Cinder_ErosionGourd.description: A strange gourd,Can release tentacles to stab enemies in the distance,occasionally this thing grows some strange tentacles.
